page.notes: The first line is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The Greek phrase after "renovari" is uncertain (marked [?]). The bracketed "[Dei sc.]" is an editorial gloss as printed in the Latin. Some words in the scan are faint or smudged and have been read as best as possible; the reading "Nesciebat" is printed with a line break in the scan. "De Ve." may be an abbreviation for "De Vet." and is marked as printed.
